description: Sidecar, the second window (spec 2026-11-13-sidecar-design.md): its events and the window calls its own title bar makes, nothing else. Its page boots no cockpit; opening an agent goes through sidecar:act to the main window. inner-size, set-size, set-position and set-always-on-top are for the S button (part 2); internal-toggle-maximize is the double click on the drag region.
